messages:
Maya (Partnerships): quick sync — EdgeCon opportunity: Redwood + Nimbus co-present 30min theatre slot + booth microdemos. Need speaker confirmations, demo readiness, booth staffing, and swag plan. can ppl drop availability?
Raj (Solutions): I can take lead on the microdemos. planning 3x 7-min demos: latency demo, multi-model routing, and cost controls.
Lina (Marketing): will need 1-sentence speaker bios + headshots by Tue. also want co-marketing blurb for marketplace launch.
Tom (Eng): demo infra questions — do we have isolated demo env for Nimbus? need a small GPU instance and network whitelist.
Sam Nimbus (Partner - NimbusCloud): confirmed on our side. we'll provide a VM pool and a partner rep (Anya) onsite. Anya can demo marketplace provisioning flow.
Priya (Product): talking points: 1) predictable latency, 2) fallbacks (model variants), 3) marketplace provisioning. want to avoid deep infra during theatre talk — focus on customer outcomes.
Aaron (Events): booth staffing: what's headcount? we can 2 staff mornings, 3 afternoons across Fri-Sat. also need power pass IDs by Wed.
Maya (Partnerships): target speaker lineup: Raj (solutions demo), Anya (Nimbus flow), Priya (product remarks). Lina — can you confirm.
Lina (Marketing): confirmed. Raj + Anya + Priya. I'll draft the bio copy now.
Tom (Eng): for demo access I'm spinning up a dedicated demo instance. sample quick test for reviewers:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer DEMO_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-7b","input":"summarize: low-latency routing test"}'
```
Tom (Eng): also reserving a single A10G for the demo (only 1 concurrent demo slot). network: allow 54.203.0.0/16 for Nimbus prov.
Raj (Solutions): demo dataset: small public support tickets. I'll scrub and push to /demos/edgecon-2026.
Maya (Partnerships): swag: what variants and qty? previous events: stickers, tee, and a small gadget (power bank). budget cap $2k. preferences?
Aaron (Events): recommend: 500 stickers, 150 tees (mix S-XL), 100 power banks (logo'd). lead time for custom power banks is 3 weeks.
Lina (Marketing): shipping: please send swag to our logistics hub: Redwood Events Ops, 410 Transit Ave, Suite 8, SF, CA 94107 — drop deadline May 2. include packing list CSV.
Sam Nimbus (Partner - NimbusCloud): Nimbus will co-fund swag 50%. we can ship partner-branded sleeves for the power banks.
Priya (Product): rehearsal: can we do a 45-min dry run Wed May 8 11:00 PT? need slide order + 2 min handoffs.
Aaron (Events): 11:00 PT works for venue A/V tech. please attach final slide deck 24h before rehearsal.
Maya (Partnerships): slide owner list: Raj (demos), Priya (talk to product), Anya (Nimbus flow, 5min). Lina attach press/press-kit.
Lina (Marketing): will prepare one co-branded press blurb + social kit. asking legal for partner logo usage now.
Tom (Eng): note — demo auth uses short-lived API keys. I'll generate demo tokens and put in 1Password path `edgecon/demos`.
Maya (Partnerships): action items recap (short):
- Raj: finalize demo scripts + dataset by Fri (action: /demos/edgecon-2026)
- Tom: demo instance + demo tokens + network whitelist (done by Mon)
- Lina: bios, headshots, co-marketing blurb, press kit (Tue)
- Priya: slide outline + talking points (Tue)
- Aaron: swag order + shipping coord + power pass (Wed)
- Sam/Anya: confirm onsite rep + marketplace demo flow (Mon)
please reply with "ack" or your availability if different.
Raj (Solutions): ack.
Tom (Eng): ack.
Lina (Marketing): ack, will upload headshots to /assets/headshots/edgecon.
Sam Nimbus (Partner - NimbusCloud): ack, Anya will arrive Thu night.
Aaron (Events): noted. starting swag PO now.
deploy-bot: Reminder: event checklist template created at /templates/event-playbook/edgecon-2026.md :pushpin: 
Maya (Partnerships): thanks team — I'll run follow-up calendar invites and a short agenda. :party:
